evidence: Climate change is driving up temperatures around the world - but particularly in Europe.

evidence: The country's health ministry said the number of deaths during a heatwave was "unprecedented".

nary_nodes.label: France deaths increased by 2,025
evidence: In France, the number of deaths recorded between 22 and 28 June increased by 2,025 - nearly 30%, the Public Health France agency announced on Friday.

nary_nodes.label: Paris region deaths rose 62%
evidence: Deaths rose by 62% in the Paris region alone.

nary_nodes.label: Figure likely an underestimate
evidence: The French health ministry said the figure was likely an "underestimate" and mortality would "therefore be higher than these initial figures".

nary_nodes.label: 72 people died by drowning
evidence: Drowning deaths soared during the heatwave, with French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez saying on Saturday that 72 people had died by drowning since 18 June.

nary_nodes.label: Netherlands recorded excess deaths
evidence: unprecedented heat in the Netherlands last week led to about 480 excess deaths, Dutch authorities said on Thursday

nary_nodes.label: Most Netherlands deaths aged 80 and older
evidence: most of whom were aged 80 and older

evidence: Temperatures reached almost 40C in parts of the country

evidence: While the Netherlands is expecting a cooler week ahead

evidence: hot weather is predicted again over the weekend elsewhere.

evidence: Temperatures are forecast to reach 40C in the south of France

nary_nodes.label: Risk of outbreak 'very high'
evidence: warning that weather conditions meant the risk of an outbreak was "very high" compared to summer norms.

nary_nodes.label: Nearly 7,000 fires broken out
evidence: On Thursday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said nearly 7,000 fires had broken out since the start of the summer season

nary_nodes.label: 8,700 hectares burned
evidence: with about 8,700 hectares burned so far.

nary_nodes.label: Nearly 3,000 people evacuated due to wildfire
evidence: Nearly 3,000 people were evacuated after a wildfire ignited in the town of Sainte-Marie-la-Mer and spread to Canet-en-Roussillon on Thursday.

nary_nodes.label: Aemet warned of another heatwave
evidence: In the Iberian Peninsula, Aemet weather service has warned of the possibility of another heatwave.

nary_nodes.label: Portugal declared state of alert
evidence: Portugal's government declared a state of alert which will remain in place until midnight on Tuesday.

nary_nodes.label: Temperatures forecast to exceed 40C in Portugal
evidence: Temperatures are forecast to exceed 40C in some areas, with overnight temperatures above 25C.

nary_nodes.label: Southwest Spain on orange alert
evidence: In Spain, areas of the southwest are on orange alert as 40C is expected in some parts.

nary_nodes.label: Anglian Water says another heatwave forecast
evidence: Anglian Water says the situation is changing very quickly with another heatwave forecast.

nary_nodes.label: UK Health Security Agency says risks may increase
evidence: The UK Health Security Agency says risks may increase when temperatures soar from Wednesday.

nary_nodes.label: Animals fell ill after record-breaking temperatures
evidence: A farm tells of how the animals fell ill after record-breaking temperatures in June.

nary_nodes.label: ReformUK's proposal rejected
evidence: ReformUK's proposal to replace net zero targets with a "resilience strategy" is rejected.
